submission.justification: Simulation scan over 2-10 mm shows F3 gives the best resolution at 100 GeV at 4 mm (3.154%), better than F2 (best 3.977% at 4 mm) and F1 (best 5.089% at 4 mm). Finer sampling at 3, 5, 7 mm confirms the minimum is near 4 mm (5 mm gives 3.16%). Caveat: the hands-on maintenance constraint could not be verified. No project documents contained maintenance information, and no material was confirmed as allowed or excluded. The recommendation is therefore conditional on confirming that F3 is acceptable for hands-on maintenance, for example with respect to activation or toxicity.
